{{Top|leg}}
The '''Pilot's Guild''' was a union of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and [[Navigator/Legends|navigators]]. An esteemed organization with strict entry and membership requirements, many companies require their employees to be members of the Guild.
